RecyclX Model¶

The RecyclX model is implemented as a specialized neural network model within the AnalysisG framework.

Header file for the RecyclX graph neural network model.

This file contains the definition of the RecyclX class, which is a graph neural network model designed for particle physics event reconstruction and classification.
